HOW IT WORKS

Set up once. Build from anywhere.

No infrastructure to provision first. Three steps, the last one is the only one you'll repeat.

01

Create an MCP API key

From your FuncHole dashboard, generate a key scoped to your account. It's the only credential your agent needs — no OAuth dance, no service account.

MCP API KEY Active
fh_mcp_8f2a1c94••••d3f6
02

Connect your agent

Paste one command into Claude Code, Codex, or opencode. FuncHole shows up as a set of tools your agent can call directly — nothing to install on your machine.

claude mcp add --transport http funchole https://app.funchole.dev/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer fh_mcp_..."
03

Build directly on FuncHole

Describe what you want. Your agent calls the same tools every time — create, submit source, deploy, inspect — and hands you back a live URL.

create_function_version submit_function_version_source deploy_function_version ✓ READY

WHAT YOU GET

Built for building things fast.

Agent-native, not agent-tolerant

Every part of the lifecycle — create, submit source, deploy, wire into a Flow, inspect — is a real MCP tool. Your agent doesn't just write the code, it ships it.

Compose real apps, not isolated functions

Flows chain your Functions into a real pipeline — logic, validation, response — instead of a pile of disconnected endpoints.

Frontend and backend, one project

A Node Function for your logic, a Static Function for your UI — the same platform serves both, so your prototype is a whole app, not half of one.

Fix forward, never from scratch

A new version automatically carries forward the last one's code, secrets, and database — so a failed build is a fix, not a restart.
